title: Molecular Gas in Three z ∼ 7 Quasar Host Galaxies
question: What are the molecular gas content (CO, [C I]), rest-frame ~400 um dust continuum and ISM excitation (PDR vs XDR) of three z~7 quasar host galaxies?

what.value: [C II] redshifts, line widths, fluxes, 1 mm continuum, L_FIR, dust masses, dynamical masses

evidence.quote: In the remainder of this paper, we will use the FIR luminosities derived from the continuum detection at 1 mm by (cite: ven16).

what.value: J1148+5251 LVG CO SLED line ratios used to extrapolate CO(1-0)

evidence.quote: we here apply the same model that fits the strength of the CO lines of the quasar host galaxy J1148+5251 at $z=6.42$ (cite: rie09; stef15)
applying the PDR and XDR models from (cite: mei05) and (cite: mei07)

recipe.goal: Extract line spectra and fit fluxes
recipe.method: Gaussian fit to spectra at [C II] position with redshift and width fixed to [C II] values
Average line-free channels; measure flux density
Modified blackbody fit to 1 mm and 3 mm points including CMB effects
assumptions: beta = 1.6 or 1.95; fixed redshift; 10% flux calibration error

recipe.goal: Derive CO(1-0) luminosity and H2 mass
recipe.method: Convert fluxes to L' and scale to CO(1-0) via J1148+5251 LVG SLED; M_gas = alpha L'
assumptions: alpha = 0.8 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1; H0=70, OmegaM=0.3

recipe.method: Compare line ratios with PDR/XDR models
assumptions: Majority of [C II] from same region as CO and [C I]

evidence.quote: We derive a line flux of $F_\mathrm{[CI]}=0.16\pm0.06$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
The \[C II\]/CO(1–0) luminosity ratios derived for three quasar hosts range from 2500 to 4200.
we derive a neutral carbon mass of $M_\mathrm{CI}=(1.0\pm0.4)\times10^7$ $M_\ensuremath{\odot}$

answer_key.quantity: PDR density and radiation field J2348–3054

evidence.quote: we derive a density of $\sim$$2\times10^5$ cm$^{-3}$ and a radiation field strength of $\sim$$10^3$ $G_0$

not_stated_but_needed: Number of clean iterations, threshold, cell and image size
Which channels were used as line-free for continuum and exact line-map widths
CASA version and calibration script details
Fitting software/sampler for the modified blackbody
score_reason: Simple short observations and clear formulae, but imaging details and fitting software unstated, and inputs depend on Venemans 2016.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, short recipe, numeric line fluxes and masses; some imaging details need inference.
